identity.title: One-Shot WP Readiness and Execution Workflow Hardening
identity.objective: Add one deterministic local/offline package-readiness gate that composes the existing WP-spec/certificate guard with prompt-structure validation, structured semantic contradiction detection, pre-implementation evidence-plan target coherence, post-implementation exact-node/assertion adequacy, exact-scope authority, and successor-boundary checks; narrowly extend wp_spec_guard so the exact .github/pull_request_template.md governance path requires both workflow_governance and canonical_evidence_policy; reconcile PR evidence tooling with the already-canonical PR-body-required/final-comment-optional post-WP91 policy; and replace three WP159-specific historical tool-scope exceptions with current-WP machine-spec authority. No product runtime, dependency, network, credential, strategy, paper, execution, live, or WP169 implementation. Additionally generalize three historical full-changed-set scope-registration guards so the active WP's authorized changed-file set is derived deterministically from its machine spec (exact-set equality preserved, fail-closed on missing/malformed/ambiguous authority), and record a bounded pre-freeze full-changed-set guard discovery requirement. Package re-scoped L->XL at 23 files under explicit user authorization for size only; no implementation authority is granted.
identity.xl_authorization_basis: Explicit user authorization to re-scope WP168G from L to XL. Beyond the three tool-scope guards already generalized, three additional historical full-changed-set registration guards (tests/test_adoption_architecture_dependency_registry_and_alpha_factory_roadmap_lock_in_docs.py, tests/test_append_only_local_manifest_and_dataset_snapshot_reference_contract_docs.py, tests/test_local_research_workflow_value_measurement_harness_contract_docs.py) assert the complete branch changed-file set against a hard-coded per-WP authorized set and fail on any unregistered WP diff. Generalizing them to derive the active WP's authorized set from its machine spec is required to keep the full suite green and needs those three files in scope, giving an exact 23-file governed scope that exceeds the L 20-file maximum. XL authorizes the package size only; it does not grant implementation authority, which remains the separate independent PASS certificate plus explicit user AUTHORIZED transition.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert WP168G. It changes only local/offline workflow governance, the existing WP-spec guard's narrow authority mapping for the exact PR-template path, the new readiness gate, the existing PR evidence guard, focused tests, bounded historical scope-guard compatibility, and status/repo-truth documentation. It adds no product runtime, dependency, data migration, generated artifact, credential, network, strategy, paper, execution, or live state.

state_transitions.reason: WP168G preserves the canonical authorization chain. The new readiness result is explicitly not an authority state. Because the new gate does not exist on the WP168G base, WP168G itself uses the existing independent draftability + explicit-user-authorization bootstrap; after WP168G, applicable implementation WPs require readiness PASS before the user grants AUTHORIZED.

items.condition: A separate independent certificate binds exact prompt/spec raw-byte hashes, all twelve lenses PASS, unresolved decisions are empty, and implementability simulation PASS.

For WP168G bootstrap, the user explicitly authorizes the exact independently certified package under the existing governance because wp_readiness_gate does not yet exist on base. For later applicable WPs after WP168G merge, package-readiness PASS is required before this human AUTHORIZED transition. Readiness never grants authority by itself.

The executor implements only the exact certified scope after explicit user authorization, without normative prompt/spec changes; WP168G must self-host the new readiness gate in final --check-diff validation before Ready for review.
